title: Microstrip on a lossy substrate (εr = 9.8, tan δ = 0.02, h = 0.635 mm, W/h = 0.945) loaded as a board, meshed by the planar mesher: its port mode's dielectric attenuation and the 4 mm line's |S21| at 1 GHz
source: The dielectric attenuation of a quasi-TEM line, α_d = k0 εr (ε_eff − 1) tan δ / (2 √ε_eff (εr − 1)) (D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., Wiley 2012, §3.8), ε_eff from E. Hammerstad and Ø. Jensen's fit (IEEE MTT-S International Microwave Symposium Digest, 1980, pp. 407–409): the value of the oracle case `lossy-microstrip`, evaluated independently of the code (0.004395612793931512 dB/mm); a matched line's |S21| = 10^(−α_d L / 20) over L = 4 mm

quantities.quantity: attenuation of the port mode at 1 GHz (dB/mm)
quantities.reason: as `lossy-microstrip`: the formula's filling factor (0.44 %), the fit's 0.2 %, the box and the cross-section's grading at the strip's edges

quantities.quantity: |S21| of the 4 mm line at 1 GHz
